description: The setup the owner opened with Connect your AI, as an owner reads a business: what is filled (the business, who it's for, what it sells with every product's name, price and number of pictures, how it looks and sounds, where it is, who it's up against, guides, answers), its own characters with their looks and its own places, the read's questions still open, the preferences questions to ask the owner (with who Marsell talks to for them, in preferences.reach), the files on the project, and what could still be added with which tool. Start here, fill it from what you know of the business (its site, its code and docs, its files, what the owner told you), then finish_setup.
